caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of patterned textile or wallpaper with a beige background featuring a recurring spiral or concentric line motif. Overlaid on this background are floral arrangements composed primarily of large red, pink, and brown flowers with green and teal-blue leaves. Thin, winding brown ribbons snake across the composition, weaving between the flowers and smaller blossoms, which are pink with yellow centers. The main floral clusters are located near the center and top right, while additional, smaller flowers and leaves are distributed throughout the design, spaced apart by the trailing ribbons. The entire scene is bordered by a narrow cream margin.
title: Printed Cotton
